source: **Chosen Method:** FDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [tdTomato (内源荧光), β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor (647)]
english: **Chosen Labeling:** [tdTomato (endogenous fluorescence), β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor (647)]

source: **Justification:** FDISCO（Fluorescence-preserved 3D Imaging of Solvent-Cleared Organs）是基于有机溶剂的快速透明方法，全脑透明可在约2天内完成，满足"尽快成像"的需求，且相比iDISCO+/uDISCO对荧光蛋白保护更佳（低温+碱性条件抑制荧光淬灭），已有文献证明可良好保留tdTomato内源信号。FDISCO使用THF脱水/脱脂后以BABB作为RI匹配液（RI≈1.56），与光片显微镜兼容，可接受一定程度的组织收缩（FDISCO收缩率约35–40%，均匀收缩不影响投射追踪）。标记策略：①保留tdTomato内源荧光追踪长程投射神经元；②在透明前对固定脑进行全脑免疫染色（iDISCO-style whole-mount），使用抗β-III Tubulin（TUJ1）抗体 + Alexa Fluor 647二抗标记轴突骨架结构，Alexa Fluor 647在有机溶剂中稳定性优异。两通道（tdTomato ~590 nm；AF647 ~647 nm）光谱分离良好，适合双通道光片成像。
english: **Justification:** FDISCO (Fluorescence-preserved 3D Imaging of Solvent-Cleared Organs) is a rapid organic-solvent-based clearing method. Whole-brain clearing can be completed in approximately 2 days, meeting the requirement for "imaging as soon as possible". It preserves fluorescent proteins better than iDISCO+/uDISCO (low temperature and alkaline conditions suppress fluorescence quenching), and published studies have demonstrated good preservation of endogenous tdTomato signals. FDISCO uses THF for dehydration/delipidation followed by BABB as the RI-matching solution (RI≈1.56), is compatible with light-sheet microscopy, and permits some tissue shrinkage (FDISCO shrinkage is approximately 35–40%; uniform shrinkage does not affect projection tracing). Labeling strategy: ① preserve endogenous tdTomato fluorescence to trace long-range projection neurons; ② perform whole-brain immunostaining of the fixed brain before clearing (iDISCO-style whole-mount), using an anti-β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) antibody + Alexa Fluor 647 secondary antibody to label the axonal cytoskeleton. Alexa Fluor 647 has excellent stability in organic solvents. The two channels (tdTomato ~590 nm; AF647 ~647 nm) are well separated spectrally and are suitable for dual-channel light-sheet imaging.

source: **Protocol Steps:**
**1 样品预处理（Post-fixation wash）**
1.1 将已4% PFA固定的成年小鼠全脑置于1× PBS中充分漂洗，去除残余固定液。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 3 × 1 hour)
english: 1.1 Place the adult mouse whole brain already fixed in 4% PFA into 1× PBS and rinse thoroughly to remove residual fixative.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 3 × 1 hour)

source: **2 全脑免疫染色前渗透处理**
2.1 将脑组织置于含0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100的1× PBS（PBST）中振荡渗透。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
english: 2.1 Place the brain tissue in 1× PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBST) and permeabilize with shaking.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

source: 2.2 更换新鲜PBST继续渗透。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
english: 2.2 Replace with fresh PBST and continue permeabilization.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

source: 3.1 将脑组织置于封闭液（5% (vol/vol) 正常驴血清 + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 0.1% (wt/vol) NaN₃ in 1× PBS）中振荡封闭。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
english: 3.1 Place the brain tissue in blocking solution (5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 0.1% (wt/vol) NaN₃ in 1× PBS) and block with shaking.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

source: **4 一抗孵育（β-III Tubulin / TUJ1）**
4.1 将脑组织置于含抗β-III Tubulin（TUJ1）兔多克隆抗体（1:500稀释于封闭液）的溶液中，轻柔振荡孵育。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
english: 4.1 Place the brain tissue in a solution containing rabbit polyclonal anti-β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) antibody (1:500 diluted in blocking solution), and incubate with gentle shaking.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

source: 4.2 用PBST洗涤，去除未结合一抗。(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)
english: 4.2 Wash with PBST to remove unbound primary antibody.(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)

source: **5 二抗孵育（Alexa Fluor 647）**
5.1 将脑组织置于含驴抗兔 Alexa Fluor 647二抗（1:500稀释于封闭液）的溶液中，避光振荡孵育。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
english: 5.1 Place the brain tissue in a solution containing donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 secondary antibody (1:500 diluted in blocking solution), and incubate with shaking protected from light.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

source: 5.2 用PBST洗涤，去除未结合二抗。(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)
english: 5.2 Wash with PBST to remove unbound secondary antibody.(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)

source: 5.3 用1× PBS终洗。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 min)
english: 5.3 Perform a final wash with 1× PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 min)

source: **6 脱水（THF梯度脱水）**
6.1 将脑组织置于50% (vol/vol) THF（四氢呋喃）水溶液（用NaOH调pH至9–10，以保护荧光蛋白）中振荡脱水。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
english: 6.1 Place the brain tissue in 50% (vol/vol) aqueous THF (tetrahydrofuran), adjusted with NaOH to pH 9–10 to protect fluorescent proteins, and dehydrate with shaking.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)

source: 6.2 将脑组织置于70% (vol/vol) THF水溶液（pH 9–10）中振荡脱水。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
english: 6.2 Place the brain tissue in 70% (vol/vol) aqueous THF (pH 9–10), and dehydrate with shaking.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)

source: 6.3 将脑组织置于80% (vol/vol) THF水溶液（pH 9–10）中振荡脱水。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
english: 6.3 Place the brain tissue in 80% (vol/vol) aqueous THF (pH 9–10), and dehydrate with shaking.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)

source: 6.4 将脑组织置于100% THF（无水，pH 9–10，加少量NaOH）中振荡脱水，第一次。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
english: 6.4 Place the brain tissue in 100% THF (anhydrous, pH 9–10, with a small amount of NaOH), and dehydrate with shaking for the first time.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)

source: 6.5 将脑组织置于100% THF（无水，pH 9–10）中振荡脱水，第二次（更换新鲜THF）。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
english: 6.5 Place the brain tissue in 100% THF (anhydrous, pH 9–10), and dehydrate with shaking for the second time (replacing with fresh THF).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)

source: **7 脱脂（BABB预处理）**
7.1 将脑组织置于BABB（苯甲醇:苯甲酸苄酯 = 1:2, vol/vol）中振荡，完成脱脂并开始RI匹配，直至组织完全透明（通常30–60 min）。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
english: 7.1 Place the brain tissue in BABB (benzyl alcohol:benzyl benzoate = 1:2, vol/vol) with shaking to complete delipidation and begin RI matching, until completely transparent (usually 30–60 min).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)

source: **8 折射率匹配（RI Matching）**
8.1 将透明脑组织转移至新鲜BABB（RI ≈ 1.56）中，避光静置平衡，确保组织完全透明且无气泡。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 2 hours)
english: 8.1 Transfer the transparent brain tissue into fresh BABB (RI ≈ 1.56) and let equilibrate without agitation, protected from light, ensuring that the tissue is completely transparent and free of bubbles.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 2 hours)

source: 8.2 再次更换新鲜BABB，确认组织完全透明，准备成像。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 30 min)
english: 8.2 Replace with fresh BABB again, confirm complete tissue transparency, and prepare for imaging.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 30 min)

source: **9 成像前处理与保存**
9.1 将透明脑组织转移至适配光片显微镜样品槽的BABB中，使用折射率匹配的浸没介质（RI = 1.56）固定样品位置，避免气泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 即刻成像)
english: 9.1 Transfer the transparent brain tissue into BABB in a light-sheet microscope sample chamber, use a refractive-index-matched immersion medium (RI = 1.56) to secure the sample position, and avoid bubbles.(Temperature: RT, Time: image immediately)

source: 9.2 若需短期保存，将样品密封于BABB中，避光、4 ℃保存（建议1周内完成成像，以防荧光信号衰减）。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: ≤ 7 days)
english: 9.2 If short-term storage is needed, seal the sample in BABB and store at 4 ℃ protected from light (imaging within 1 week is recommended to avoid fluorescent signal decay).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: ≤ 7 days)
